question: What evidence would show a tokenized-stock venue is actually using the exemption?
answer: The research separates the legal gates, ecosystem-fit assessments and receipts needed to establish actual use. A legally available exemption or a capable technology is not evidence of a running venue or completed trade.

sections.title: Search the complete records
sections.sub: Search names, page or question numbers and the full saved wording. Every card retains its source and exact complete-reference link.

groups.label: Innovation Exemption overlay: the eight gates
groups.note: Label: Core technical candidate; Meaning: A public-chain execution or AMM layer appears capable of addressing the order's core technical surface, subject to the exact deployment and every legal condition.; Label: Conditional or unresolved candidate; Meaning: A relevant component exists, but the public-permissionless, AMM, rights or exact deployment fit is unresolved or depends on a specific network variant.; Label: Supporting control layer; Meaning: The system could support issuance, recordkeeping, identity, custody, data, interoperability, liquidity, cash or settlement without itself being the qualifying TSV base venue.; Label: Outside the core venue design; Meaning: The tracked system as currently described is permissioned, proprietary or functionally different from the required public-permissionless AMM venue, though it may connect externally.

kv: Twenty governed ecosystems compared against the order's venue, chain, asset, record, liquidity and settlement conditions.

rows.label: Which tracked technologies overlap the Innovation Exemption?

cells.text: Summary: The order creates a permission category, not a vendor list. This matrix identifies where a tracked system has a technically or institutionally relevant component and what must still be proved before it can be called…
cells.label: The order creates a permission category, not a vendor list. This matrix identifies where a tracked system has a technically or institutionally relevant component and what must still be proved before it can be called part of a Tokenized Securities Venue.

cells.text: Boundary: Every row remains not selected and not operating under Release 34-106402. Core candidate means architectural overlap only; it does not establish legal qualification, integration,…
cells.label: Every row remains not selected and not operating under Release 34-106402. Core candidate means architectural overlap only; it does not establish legal qualification, integration, issuer acceptance, a TSV notice, an eligible pool or observed trading.

cells.text: Rule: A U.S.-person TSV must publish the complete required notice at least 30 calendar days before operating and notify the SEC within one business day.
cells.label: A U.S.-person TSV must publish the complete required notice at least 30 calendar days before operating and notify the SEC within one business day.

cells.text: Watch: First notice, operator, affiliates, operating date and later material amendments.
cells.label: First notice, operator, affiliates, operating date and later material amendments.

cells.text: Rule: The smart contracts and DLT applications must be auditable, public and deployed on public, permissionless DLT while market access remains permissioned.
cells.label: The smart contracts and DLT applications must be auditable, public and deployed on public, permissionless DLT while market access remains permissioned.

cells.text: Watch: Named chain, contract addresses, code, upgrades, pause or override keys and admission controls.
cells.label: Named chain, contract addresses, code, upgrades, pause or override keys and admission controls.

cells.text: Rule: At least one pool leg must be Tokenized NMS Stock with equivalent economic and governance rights; unaffiliated third-party tokenization carries a separate issuer notice and objection clock.
cells.label: At least one pool leg must be Tokenized NMS Stock with equivalent economic and governance rights; unaffiliated third-party tokenization carries a separate issuer notice and objection clock.

cells.text: Watch: Named stock, sponsor or tokenizer, issuer receipt or objection, rights audit and transfer-agent record model.
cells.label: Named stock, sponsor or tokenizer, issuer receipt or objection, rights audit and transfer-agent record model.

cells.text: Rule: The other leg may be another Tokenized NMS Stock, any non-security crypto asset or a tokenized money market fund.
cells.label: The other leg may be another Tokenized NMS Stock, any non-security crypto asset or a tokenized money market fund.

cells.text: Watch: Named pair, asset classification, issuer or fund, redemption chain, market depth and route share.
cells.label: Named pair, asset classification, issuer or fund, redemption chain, market depth and route share.

cells.text: Rule: A Covered Firm may provide own-account Tokenized NMS Stock liquidity under the dealer exemption; agreements, compensation and token incentives must be disclosed.
cells.label: A Covered Firm may provide own-account Tokenized NMS Stock liquidity under the dealer exemption; agreements, compensation and token incentives must be disclosed.

cells.text: Watch: Pool curves, liquidity provider, gross and net inventory, financing, hedges, fees, rebates and incentives.
cells.label: Pool curves, liquidity provider, gross and net inventory, financing, hedges, fees, rebates and incentives.

cells.text: Rule: Symbol and ADV caps, ten-minute machine-readable transaction reporting and underlying-market halt synchronization constrain the lane.
cells.label: Symbol and ADV caps, ten-minute machine-readable transaction reporting and underlying-market halt synchronization constrain the lane.

cells.text: Watch: Eligible tier, volume utilization, transaction feed, after-hours pricing, issuer events and pause history.
cells.label: Eligible tier, volume utilization, transaction feed, after-hours pricing, issuer events and pause history.

cells.text: Rule: The order does not supply issuance, transfer-agent, custody, clearing-agency, Investment Company Act, bank-money or participant-wide relief.
cells.label: The order does not supply issuance, transfer-agent, custody, clearing-agency, Investment Company Act, bank-money or participant-wide relief.

cells.text: Watch: Exact legal entities, registrations, service agreements, books, customer-property treatment and affiliate separation.
cells.label: Exact legal entities, registrations, service agreements, books, customer-property treatment and affiliate separation.

cells.text: Rule: Clearing and settlement arrangements, cybersecurity, BCDR, corporate actions and material operational events must be disclosed, but the order does not itself create finality or a complete loss waterfall.
cells.label: Clearing and settlement arrangements, cybersecurity, BCDR, corporate actions and material operational events must be disclosed, but the order does not itself create finality or a complete loss waterfall.

cells.text: Watch: Two-leg settlement receipt, authoritative record, cash discharge, correction powers, default rules and observed incidents.
cells.label: Two-leg settlement receipt, authoritative record, cash discharge, correction powers, default rules and observed incidents.

catalog_context.title: SEC allows a limited tokenized-stock exemption through 2031
catalog_context.answer: On September 17, 2026 the SEC issued a live five-year order letting approved participants trade tokenized versions of listed stocks through automated pools on public blockchains.
